title: Sprint 7 - Advanced Aggregation & Math
description: Complete all MongoDB queries in this sprint.

tickets.title: User's Todo List
tickets.description:
The front-end needs to display the task title alongside the username. Join the collections to fetch `username` and `title`. Hide `_id`.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT u.username, t.title 
FROM users u 
INNER JOIN todos t ON u.id = t.user_id;
```
tasks: The front-end needs to display the task title alongside the username. Join the collections to fetch `username` and `title`. Hide `_id`.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to unwind the lookup result array.
hints: Use $lookup on users, $unwind the resulting array, and $project to format.

tickets.title: All Users and Their Tasks
tickets.description:
Get a list of ALL users, along with their tasks. If a user hasn't created any tasks, they should still appear in the list with a null/empty task title.

### SQL Equivalent
```sql
SELECT u.username, t.title 
FROM users u 
LEFT JOIN todos t ON u.id = t.user_id;
```
tasks: Get a list of ALL users, along with their tasks. If a user hasn't created any tasks, they should still appear in the list with a null/empty task title.
learning_objectives: Perform a left join using `$lookup` and `$unwind`.
common_mistakes: Using simple unwind which drops users without tasks.
hints: Use $unwind with option { path: "$t", preserveNullAndEmptyArrays: true }.
